facts.fact: A 34-member committee was installed on 27 April 2026 by the telecoms and digital economy minister with 45 days to propose modernised digital texts, including on personal data protection, which the minister called inadequately covered by current rules.
facts.system: Committee for overhaul of the digital legal framework

TCD.note: Names a planned digital code and a legal overhaul committee, no national digital strategy stated.
